messages:
rachel: quick triage: onboarding cynosure7b (7B) with our int8 pipeline. unit tests pass but generation QA fails on multi-turn factual QA — answers flip entity order and token repetition spikes. opening thread to collect hypotheses.

tom: can you drop the quant/convert config and an example prompt + outputs?

rachel: config: 
```
convert_cmd: ./convert_ckpt --layout=hf --qtype=int8 --preserve_layout=false
attention_layout: qkv
rotary_pack: interleaved
token_norm: none
```
repro prompt: "List the authors of 19th century paper X and their affiliations."
fp16: "Authors: A. Smith (Univ A), B. Li (Inst B)."
int8: "Authors: Li A., Smith B. Affiliations: Univ B, Inst A."

vivek: interesting. two immediate suspects: 1) q/k/v packing/order mismatch in our kernels (qkv vs kqv) causing headwise shuffling, 2) rotary sin/cos packing order (interleaved vs separate) mismatch. both can reorder token salience. also token normalization might change token boundaries for initials which flips author order in prefix-matching.

anita: small repro: can you paste shapes of first attention weight matrix and a small slice of q/k matrices? also give tokenizer ids for "A. Smith" vs "Smith, A."

rachel: shapes: (num_heads=64, head_dim=64) qkv_proj shape from ckpt (3, 4096, 4096) we reshape -> (3, num_heads, head_dim, out) in converter. dumping q[:2] slice and k[:2] slice attached. tokenizer ids: "A." -> [1123, 45], "Smith" -> [2045], "Smith, A." -> [2045, 1123, 45].

tom: converter note: when unpacking hf qkv kernel we do: 
```
# old (bug)
qkv = ckpt['qkv.weight']  # shape (3*D, D)
q, k, v = np.split(qkv, 3, axis=0)
# reshape assumes q,k,v contiguous in head-major order
```
some hf checkpoints use k,q,v ordering or interleaved packing. if order mismatch, heads get permuted.

vivek: also check rotary packing: we expect sin_cos interleaved per-head, but some repos store separate arrays sin, cos per head. converter currently flattens into one vector, which can flip cos/sin interleaving. that will create phase offsets in attention for alternating heads.

ci-bot: CI alert: unit-test "attention_layout_consistency" failed for cynosure7b convert: expected layout 'qkv' but detected 'kqv' (confidence 0.92). See /ci/4589/att_layout.log

anita: ok assign: tom to add a detection pass that inspects qkv kernel correlations to infer packing (k<->q correlation low when mismatched), vivek to add rotary format auto-detect and handle interleaved vs separate sin/cos, rachel to run tokenization parity tests for 5k common tokens and a small knowledgeQA run.

tom: quick patch: 
```
# detect qkv order by correlating output with bias pattern
corr = np.corrcoef(q.flatten(), ckpt['k_guess'].flatten())[0,1]
if corr < 0.5:
    # try permutations
    for perm in permutations([0,1,2]):
         try_perm()
```
adding fallback to try all 6 orders.

vivek: token norm: noticed training data used simple casefold + NFKC. converter applied no casefold, which makes initials tokenization inconsistent ("A." vs "a."). adding `--token-norm=casefold+NFKC` flag for converter.

rachel: ran quick parity: token-id mismatches around punctuation drop from 0.8% -> 0.02% after enabling casefold+NFKC. small generator run (50 cases) shows author-order flip gone in 47/50. good signal. full QA suite scheduled on staging.

anita: note for rollout: perf teams, if we auto-detect/permute qkv we might add conversion latency; recommend caching converted artifacts and adding CI check to verify layout hash matches expected. also runtime kernels need to support both rotary packings efficiently — otherwise enable as opt-in.

tom: pushed converter patch with permutation fallback + unit tests. also added a small heuristic to detect interleaved sin_cos shapes. PR: https://redwood-internal/repos/conv/merge/789

ci-bot: conversion smoke: PASS for cynosure7b after patches. artifacts at /ci/4589/artifacts/4959998888/convert_bundle.tar.gz

vivek: follow-ups: 1) add converter flag `--force-rotary=interleaved|separate`, 2) add token-parity CI job (1k tokens). I'll own the token job.

rachel: filing issue for runtime perf check + rollback plan: https://redwood-internal/ops/issue/1401. thanks team :rocket:
